description: Converts multiple-choice correct answers and free-response points into a weighted composite and an estimated AP score, using the scoring worksheet and conversion chart College Board printed in its official practice exams. Only for the 7 exams with such a worksheet: AP Calculus AB (2012), AP Biology (2013), AP Statistics (2012), AP World History (2013), AP Psychology (2012), AP Macroeconomics (2012), AP Microeconomics (2012). Cut scores are never invented; other exams return an error.

exam.description: AP exam name or common short name, e.g. "AP Biology", "APUSH", "Calc BC", "Lang", "Physics 1", "APES".

free_response_points.description: Points earned on each free-response question, in order. The error message lists how many questions and the maximum for each.

multiple_choice_correct.description: Number of multiple-choice questions answered correctly.

name: estimate_ap_score_from_composite
title: Estimate an AP score from practice exam raw points
